title: jasminum nervosum var. villosum
intro: Jasminum nervosum var. villosum, commonly known as Jasmine, is a plant species belonging to the Oleaceae family. The plant is known for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce anxiety and stress levels, promote relaxation, and improve sleep quality. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its sedative and calming effects, which are achieved through the release of neurotransmitters such as serotonin and dopamine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
